item.title: Correction · Kaiser Permanente San Francisco Mission Bay Medical Offices: A 2013 SocketSite reader…
item.description: A 2013 SocketSite reader comment calls the building "a developer building which was already approved by the planning commission and building department"; it does not name the developer, and no source read says Kaiser bought the building. The $50,000,000 is the cost stated on the interior fit-out permit, a permit valuation and not a construction cost. Source: https://socketsite.com/archives/2013/12/kaisers_modern_mission_bay_building_slated_for_2016_ope.html ; https://data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=201312194614.

item.title: Correction · Kaiser Permanente San Francisco Mission Bay Medical Offices: The record said Kaiser…
item.description: The record said Kaiser bought the building outright from Alexandria for a stated price in a sale that closed Dec 20, 2013, per Alexandria's SEC filing. That filing never mentions Kaiser, 1600 Owens or a sale, and the price had printed as broken text, so the sale date, price and seller are removed; STUDIOS Architecture says only that Kaiser purchased the project. The March 2016 opening now reads as announced (Potrero View, February 2016: opens next month) rather than confirmed, alongside STUDIOS' completed-2016. Potrero View says nine stories, like STUDIOS; only the Assessor says 10. A milestone that cited only SocketSite's home page for a Dec 2013 deal was removed, and citations that named only a website now link the pages read. The 'fee-manager' wording was dropped since no source states it. Source: STUDIOS Architecture, 1600 Owens Kaiser Medical Office Building (https://studios.com/1600-owens-kaiser-medical-office-building.html); Potrero View, 2016-02 (https://www.potreroview.net/kaiser-permanente-mission-bay-medical-offices-to-open-in-march/); Alexandria Real Estate Equities 3Q14 supplemental, SEC (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1035443/000103544314000075/a3q14-ex991.htm) (does not state this); DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json).
item.source: STUDIOS Architecture, 1600 Owens Kaiser Medical Office Building (https://studios.com/1600-owens-kaiser-medical-office-building.html); Potrero View, 2016-02 (https://www.potreroview.net/kaiser-permanente-mission-bay-medical-offices-to-open-in-march/); Alexandria Real Estate Equities 3Q14 supplemental, SEC (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1035443/000103544314000075/a3q14-ex991.htm) (does not state this); DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json)

item.title: Added · Kaiser Permanente San Francisco Mission Bay Medical Offices: Kaiser Permanente Mission Bay…
item.description: Kaiser Permanente Mission Bay Medical Offices added as an active Assessor-parcel record (blklot 8709020, 1600 Owens St): an outpatient medical office building built speculatively by Alexandria Real Estate Equities that, per its architect STUDIOS, Kaiser purchased (sale date not sourced). Completed 2016; announced in February 2016 to open that March. Stories (nine per STUDIOS and Potrero View, 10 per the Assessor), square footage (200,000-250,884 sq ft) and LEED rating (Platinum vs Gold) differ across sources and are left unresolved rather than picked arbitrarily. Source: STUDIOS Architecture, 1600 Owens Kaiser Medical Office Building (https://studios.com/1600-owens-kaiser-medical-office-building.html); Potrero View, 2016-02 (https://www.potreroview.net/kaiser-permanente-mission-bay-medical-offices-to-open-in-march/); DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json).
item.source: STUDIOS Architecture, 1600 Owens Kaiser Medical Office Building (https://studios.com/1600-owens-kaiser-medical-office-building.html); Potrero View, 2016-02 (https://www.potreroview.net/kaiser-permanente-mission-bay-medical-offices-to-open-in-march/); DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json)
